items.prompt: A classic MSN-Games-era checkers piece, top-down view, perfectly round disc shape, FACETED CUT GEMSTONE style like a polished cut DIAMOND or CLEAR QUARTZ. The piece color is BRIGHT WHITE / PEARL WHITE / ICY WHITE — pure white with cool icy tint. DO NOT make it blue, DO NOT make it dark, DO NOT make it gray. The disc body is white (#f5f8ff to #d8dee8) with very pale cool silver shading. Multiple short triangular FACETS visible like a cut gem, several bright WHITE SPARKLE highlights scattered across surface. Soft pale silver-gray outer rim band on edge. Cartoony bright 2D rendering. NO BLUE TINT. NO black blob. NO text, NO crown. Centered on transparent background. 1024x1024 PNG transparent.
